pages.title: Berryflow
pages.creator: JCube asbl
pages.description: Berryflow mixes berry matching with a liquid-sorting puzzle. Drag through berries of the same color to juice them, then pour the top layers between glasses until each mocktail has a single color. Fizz tablets remove a layer, and syrup can blend colors. The 70 levels have no timer and introduce twists such as ice and color-changing berries.

pages.title: Russian Treasure Hunter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Russian Treasure Hunter puts you in a mining town with a detector and a backpack. Follow the strengthening signal, dig up the find and return to town to sell it. Space in the backpack matters, so decide what to carry and when to head back. Spend the proceeds on upgrades before your next search.

pages.title: Stardom Alt-Girls Fashion Duel
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Stardom Alt-Girls Fashion Duel lets you style Sydney and Sabrina in alternative looks, from soft grunge to dark rock. Try sharp eyeliner and sparkles, then choose a hairstyle and layer pieces such as corsets, miniskirts and oversized jackets. Use the two characters to experiment with different ways of putting those pieces together.

pages.title: Wave Road 3D
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Wave Road 3D sends an arrow down a floating course lined with gears and traps. Steer through the openings and grab gems when you can reach them safely. Classic mode has twenty courses, endless mode lets you chase a high score, and two-player mode lets you race a friend head to head.

pages.title: Number Tubes
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Number Tubes is a sorting puzzle where matching numbers can grow into bigger ones. Tap to move a ball between tubes and merge it with another ball of the same value. Keep some space free so you can set up the next pair. There is no timer, so you can plan each move before chasing a higher score.

pages.title: Dalgona Master
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Dalgona Master is a precision game about carving shapes out of honeycomb candy. Work along the outline and take care around narrow sections where a slip could break the piece. The goal is to separate the shape intact. Each outline gives you a different set of edges to follow as you carve.

pages.title: Geometry Wave Hero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Geometry Wave Hero focuses on the wave movement from Geometry Dash. Use one-touch controls to steer the wave through a course of obstacles. Watch where the next opening is before changing direction. The route tests how precisely you can time each move as you follow the rhythm and keep the wave clear of hazards.

pages.title: Jelly-Belly. Make the Elephant
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Jelly-Belly. Make the Elephant is a drop-and-merge puzzle. Drop animals into the container so two of the same type touch and turn into a larger animal. Plan where each piece will land to make room for later drops. Build up to the elephant without letting the pile cross the top line.

pages.title: The Walking Deadblocks
pages.creator: Pinq Games
pages.description: The Walking Deadblocks is a cooperative zombie survival game with a day-night cycle. Manage resources and make use of each character's abilities to fend off waves. Prepare generators and lights before nightfall, when enemies can emerge from different locations. See how long your group can hold out as you work toward unlocking more maps.

pages.title: Mine Sweeper
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Mine Sweeper is the classic puzzle about opening safe squares on a minefield. The numbers on revealed squares count the mines next to them. Compare nearby clues to work out which squares are safe and which should be flagged. Clear the safe part of the board without clicking on a mine.

pages.title: Zombie Idle Defense
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Zombie Idle Defense has you hold a position against waves of zombies. Set up automatic turrets and improve your weapons so your defenses can handle the next group. Watch how the line holds while the turrets fire. Upgrade the weapons as the attacks build and keep the undead from overrunning your position.

pages.title: Maze Cube 2048
pages.creator: GameCipher
pages.description: Maze Cube 2048 is a number-merging puzzle played inside a maze. Swipe to slide your cube and look for other cubes with the same value. Bring them together to make a larger number. Check where each swipe will leave the cube so the walls do not cut off your next move.

pages.title: Push The Frog
pages.creator: Nova Gaming
pages.description: Push The Frog asks you to eat every mosquito on the board. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and press Space to extend the frog's tongue. Check its reach before moving into position. Plan a route from one insect to the next so you can clear the board without stretching from too far away.

pages.title: Pocket Car Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Pocket Car Master combines building, parking and robot combat. Collect parts and merge them into a robot car, then guide the finished vehicle into the matching parking area. Take it into fights against other robots and spend earned coins on upgrades. Keep progressing to unlock more cars to build and drive.

pages.title: Wild West Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Wild West Match follows Bonnie across the frontier in a match-three puzzle. Connect at least three matching items and work toward the goal shown for each level. You have only so many moves, so look for matches that help with the current target. Use TNT to clear obstacles when they get in the way.

pages.title: Alphabet Merge and Fight
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Alphabet Merge and Fight turns letter monsters into a fighting roster. Drag matching monsters together to evolve them into stronger forms, then use the creatures you have built in 3D battles. Experiment with different combinations as you fill out the collection. The monsters you merge give you new options for later fights.

pages.title: City Builder
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: City Builder is a timing game where you construct buildings one block at a time. Click or tap to drop the next piece and try to line it up with the section beneath it. Aim for a precise placement as the structure gets taller. Use those stacks to build up the city.

pages.title: Hide and Escape Puzzle Game
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Hide and Escape Puzzle Game lets you play as the hider or the seeker. Move your character with the mouse. When hiding, find a place to stay out of sight before the search starts. When seeking, work through the area and catch the hidden characters until you have found them all.

pages.title: Brain Out in LoveStory
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Brain Out in LoveStory follows a couple through scenes with hidden objects and logic puzzles. Read the assignment, then move the scanner over the characters and their surroundings to look for the object you need. Click it once you find it. Each successful search helps the couple through another predicament.

pages.title: Stall Life Simulation
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stall Life Simulation puts you in charge of a market stall. Sell goods to customers and earn money from the business. The game gives your earnings another purpose by letting you invest in education for children who need support. Work through the selling tasks and decide how to use the profits you make.

pages.title: Fashion Trip Dress Up Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Fashion Trip Dress Up Games lets you build a doll's look from her face to her coat. Choose details such as eyelids, irises and eye shadow individually, then try a hairstyle. Mix dresses, tops, trousers and outerwear to make an outfit. Change individual pieces as you see how the clothes and makeup work together.

pages.title: Wild Animal Care And Salon
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Wild Animal Care And Salon lets you look after wild animals in a care and grooming simulation. Feed each animal, treat its problems, groom it and spend time playing with it. As you make progress, new animals become available. Pay attention to what each one needs before moving on to the next patient.

pages.title: My Perfect Halloween Costume
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: My Perfect Halloween Costume sends a group of princesses trick-or-treating. Open the wardrobe and pick a costume for each friend. Try different pieces together to see what kind of Halloween look you can make. You can give the group a shared theme or put together a different style for each princess.

pages.title: Merge Blast
pages.creator: Ember Whirl
pages.description: Merge Blast is a castle defense game where the danger comes from falling rocks. Hold to shoot at the rocks, and merge cards to improve the turrets protecting your castle. Open chests for rewards as you progress. Keep the defenses standing as you work toward level twenty-five.

pages.title: Noob vs Pro Castle Defence
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Noob vs Pro Castle Defence puts Noob and Pro in charge of a castle under attack. Take up weapons and fight off the monsters and stickmen that threaten their territory. Watch where the attackers are gathering and deal with the ones closing in. Keep the castle protected as you face the next group.

pages.title: Ball 2048!
pages.creator: DDSH
pages.description: Ball 2048! is a runner where the ball grows by merging with balls that show the same number. Steer toward a match to build a higher value, then look for another ball that matches the new number. Keep the chain of merges going to reach 2048 and raise your score.

pages.title: Cube Blast
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Cube Blast asks you to clear groups of at least two blocks of the same color. Look at which groups are available and think about how a clear will change the board. Choose a group that gives you room for another move. Complete the level and try to improve your score.

pages.title: Masks Heroes Racing Kid
pages.creator: 6woo.com
pages.description: Masks Heroes Racing Kid combines a car workshop with an obstacle race. Pick one of the masked heroes, then paint and customize a car in the garage. Take it onto the track and steer past the obstacles. Change the design between races to see how a different car looks with your favorite character.

pages.title: Garbage Rampage
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Garbage Rampage turns a truck drive into a road cleanup. Steer toward the junk scattered along the route and collect as much of it as you can. The truck uses fuel as it goes, so watch for canisters and move into position to pick them up. Refuel along the way to keep the cleanup going.

pages.title: Colors Of Holi
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Colors Of Holi is a board puzzle where you move pots of color to empty squares. Line up five or more pots of the same color to clear them and make room for new ones. Use power-ups if the grid gets crowded. Plan moves around the space you will need for your next line.

pages.title: Roller Ball 6 : Bounce Ball 6
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Roller Ball 6 : Bounce Ball 6 takes a red ball through a factory full of lasers and hostile machines. Use the arrow keys to roll and jump, collect stars along the way and land on enemies from above to defeat them. Watch their corners and keep the ball moving toward the goal.

pages.title: Winding Road
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Winding Road is a driving game about keeping a truck on a narrow, twisting route. Follow the bends and steer away from the edges, since going too far to either side can end the run. Look beyond the current turn so you are ready when the road curves in the opposite direction.

pages.title: Among Rampage
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Among Rampage sends its characters through dungeons full of traps. Jump or slide to avoid the obstacles and reach the goal at the end of each level. Collect coins along the way to unlock new avatars. Look ahead as you run so you have time to choose how to get past each hazard.

pages.title: Car Destroy Car
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Car Destroy Car is a demolition driving game about taking out rival cars. Drift into position and ram opponents before they can do too much damage to your own vehicle. Keep an eye on your damage between hits. If it reaches 100 percent, the attempt ends and you have to try the level again.

pages.title: Airplane Puzzles
pages.creator: NEOX LLC
pages.description: Airplane Puzzles has ten illustrated aircraft scenes to put back together. Drag the pieces into place and choose a 25-, 49- or 100-piece layout. Harder puzzles award more in-game money. Save up $1,000 of that currency to unlock another image, such as a cartoon plane or a pilot in a propeller aircraft.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Ice Princess Dressup
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Ice Princess Dressup turns Hazel into an ice princess. Pick a dress, hairstyle and tiara, then finish the outfit with makeup, jewelry or a wand. You also get to choose a royal animal. Try a bunny, penguin, dog or unicorn alongside Hazel to complete the scene.

pages.title: Motorbike Beach Fighter 3D
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Motorbike Beach Fighter 3D takes a motocross bike onto a tropical beach with stunt ramps. Use the arrow keys to ride toward a ramp and jump off it for points. Look for another ramp as soon as you land so you can fit more stunts into the run. Aim for a high score before time runs out.

pages.title: Princess Pet Rescuer
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Pet Rescuer starts after Princess Mia's pet has an accident. Help look after the injured animal and work through the treatments until its wounds are taken care of. Once the pet has recovered, switch to dress-up and choose an outfit for Mia to wear while she celebrates its recovery.

pages.title: Deer Hunting Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Deer Hunting Jigsaw is a picture puzzle with twelve hunting-themed images. Choose a picture and put it together from 25, 49 or 100 pieces. Start with larger features you can recognize, then use small details to work out where the remaining pieces fit. Try another piece count for a different challenge.

pages.title: Animal Happy Drive Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Animal Happy Drive Coloring offers eight pictures of animals on the move. Pick a picture and use the 23 colors to fill in the animals, vehicles and scenery. The game scores how quickly you finish. You can also save a copy if you want to keep a particular color combination.

pages.title: Luxury Limo Taxi Driver City Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Luxury Limo Taxi Driver City Game is a 3D driving and parking simulator built around a limousine. Guide the long car through the driving area and line it up with the parking space. Account for the length of the vehicle when turning so you leave room to bring the back of the limo around.

pages.title: Dunk It Up
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Dunk It Up is a basketball shooting game where clean baskets earn coins. Aim for the hoop and adjust the next shot based on where the last one went. Keep scoring to raise your total. Spend the coins you earn on new basketballs, then take another run with the ball you picked.

pages.title: Baby Panda Color Mixing Studio
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Baby Panda Color Mixing Studio follows Miumiu as she hides from a rat that wants her lollipop. Use the paints and magic potions in the studio to mix colors and help hide the panda and her candy. Try the combinations the scene calls for and see how the new colors help her stay hidden.

pages.title: Water Slide Jet Boat Race 3D
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Water Slide Jet Boat Race 3D puts you on a jet ski for races along water tracks. Steer around obstacles while trying to keep your speed up. Watch the route ahead before moving across the track so you have time to get clear. Try the different race categories as you get used to handling the craft.

pages.title: Happy Valentines Day Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Happy Valentines Day Coloring gives you Valentine pictures to personalize. Use the mouse or tap to choose colors and apply them to the image. Try a palette that suits the card you want to make. When the picture is ready, print it to turn your design into a Valentine's gift.

pages.title: Mouse Key
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Mouse Key is an arcade distance game about keeping a wind-up mouse moving. Guide the toy into keys to give it more power. Look for the next key while you still have enough energy to reach it. The farther the mouse travels, the more points you earn, so each pickup helps extend the run.

pages.title: Carrom
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Carrom is a two-player tabletop game where you aim a striker to knock your pieces into the pockets. Look for a clear angle before sending the striker across the board. Try to leave yourself a good shot on the pieces that remain. Pot your set before the other player does to win.

pages.title: Cut The Wood
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Cut The Wood is an arcade slicing game where you swipe through pieces of wood as they fly into view. Try to catch several pieces in one stroke, but keep the blade clear of bombs. Classic and Arcade have separate best scores, so you can work on improving your runs in either mode.

pages.title: Monster Candy
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Monster Candy is a matching puzzle where the monsters eat the candy you line up. Use the mouse or a finger to move pieces into a row of at least three matching candies. Look for the next group after a match clears. Feed the monsters and keep working through the levels.

pages.title: Color vs block
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Color vs block asks you to guide an arrow through a field of colored blocks. Steer toward blocks that match the arrow and avoid the ones of other colors. Watch for the next safe route while you collect the current group. Keep the run going to build your score and beat your best.

pages.title: PUBG Infinity BattleField OPS
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: PUBG Infinity BattleField OPS is a battle royale shooter where the goal is to survive to the end. Use the mouse to aim and shoot, and press R to reload. Open your parachute with Space on the way in, then use vehicles and grenades as you fight to remain the last survivor.

pages.title: Heroes Battle
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Heroes Battle is a strategy game where you send fighters into battle to protect your fortress. Choose units such as archers and watch how your lineup handles the enemy wave. Adjust what you send out when the opposition changes. Upgrade your fighters between battles to prepare for the later stages.

pages.title: Air Dogs of WW2
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Air Dogs of WW2 lets you choose the Allied or German side in a World War II air battle. Steer with the mouse, left-click to fire and right-click to drop bombs. Attack the enemy base before time expires while keeping your own side in the fight. The side that deals the most damage wins.

pages.title: Blocks Super Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Blocks Super Match3 asks you to clear blocks by making matches of three or more. Scan the board for pieces you can bring together, then see what is left after the match clears. Look for a move that creates space for another combination if the board is crowded with different blocks.

pages.title: Koala Sling
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Koala Sling is an endless climbing game where you pull and release to send a koala from one point to the next. Adjust the launch to swing or bounce past hazards that can burn or crush it. Collect coins for new skins such as a panda or an octopus, and see how high you can climb.

pages.title: EG Zombie Uprising
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Zombie Uprising is an arcade defense game where you click or tap to crush approaching zombies. Watch for different types as you work through the levels. Pick up extra lives and use bombs when the crowd builds up. Keep the zombies from wearing down your lives and see how high you can score.

pages.title: Acura Type S Concept Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Acura Type S Concept Puzzle gives you six pictures of the concept car to assemble. Pick an image and choose from 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Match the car's lines and the background details to put the picture together. Increase the piece count when you want to revisit a picture with smaller pieces.

pages.title: Endless Flight
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Endless Flight is an arcade survival game where you guide your character through waves of obstacles. Use the mouse to control the flight and pick up coins when the path is clear. Look for power-ups such as a coin magnet or temporary protection. Keep going to raise your score and complete distance or collection goals.

pages.title: Tic Tac Toe Office
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Tic Tac Toe Office plays the familiar three-in-a-row game with sticky notes. Face a friend or the computer and take turns placing marks on the grid. Look for a row, column or diagonal you can complete while watching for your opponent's next move. Get three in a line to win the round.

pages.title: PUBG PIXEL
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: PUBG PIXEL is a multiplayer battle royale with blocky graphics. Stay alive as the field of players is reduced and fight to be the last person or team standing. The game supports matches of up to a hundred players. Pay attention to nearby threats as you decide where to move and when to engage.

pages.title: Get 13
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Get 13 is a number-merging puzzle where the goal is to build a tile worth thirteen. Bring matching numbers together to create a higher value, then look for another match with the new tile. Plan the next merge while there is room on the board. Try endless play or race the clock in timed mode.

pages.title: Fairy Insta Selfie
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Fairy Insta Selfie combines room decorating with fairy dress-up. Choose the wallpaper, mirror and table decorations to set up the shot. Then try on dresses and hairstyles until the fairy's look works with the scene. Prepare both the outfit and the backdrop so the fairy is ready to take her selfie.

pages.title: Fast Arrow
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Fast Arrow is a timing game about firing arrows into a circular target. Tap to shoot when there is space for another arrow. Watch the arrows already in the target and wait for a clear gap before firing again. Keep landing shots without hitting an earlier arrow to build your score.

pages.title: Gotia.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Gotia.io is a multiplayer arena game built around swords and shields. Grow your fighter and close in on other players when you have room to swing. Watch the space around you, since another player can move in while you are focused on a rival. Try to get bigger and knock opponents away.

pages.title: Cyborg Slayer
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cyborg Slayer is a shooting game played across three levels of platforms. Move between them to take on enemy machines and cyborgs. Watch for enemies on another platform while you deal with the ones in front of you. Collect coins from defeated targets and use them to unlock more playable characters.

pages.title: Rapunzel Scary Movie
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Rapunzel Scary Movie puts Rapunzel in Flint's movie club for a horror film she would rather avoid. Help her get through the screening by completing small distractions that take her mind off the movie. Use clicks or taps to work through the activities and keep her occupied while she sits with Flint.

pages.title: Connect The Gems
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Connect The Gems is a puzzle about linking gems of the same color. Connect three or more and check which gems the level still needs before choosing another match. You have a limited number of moves to reach the target. Later boards introduce new ways to match and give you more demanding layouts to solve.

pages.title: Apple Shooter Remastered
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Apple Shooter Remastered is an archery game where the target is an apple on someone's head. Aim for the fruit and judge the shot before letting the arrow go. The person holding still is close to your target, so make each shot count. Hit the apple without hitting him to succeed.

pages.title: Knife Challenge
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Knife Challenge asks you to throw all your knives into a rotating target. Watch where the blades already in the target are headed and time each throw for a free spot. The openings get smaller as more knives stick. Use the whole set without hitting an earlier knife to finish the challenge.

pages.title: The Cars.io
pages.creator: Pegasus Web Co
pages.description: The Cars.io is a driving arena game where picking up dots lengthens the trail behind your car. Collect dots while steering around other cars and the tracks they leave. Look ahead for a way out before driving into a crowded part of the arena. Keep the car moving as you build a longer trail.

pages.title: Zombie Invasion Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Zombie Invasion Game asks you to stop zombies from crossing a bridge. Take out the undead while letting fleeing survivors reach safety. Each zombie that gets through costs energy, while saving survivors can help restore it. Pay attention to who is approaching before you act and see how long you can hold the crossing.

pages.title: My Halloween Items
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: My Halloween Items is a memory game with Halloween pictures hidden under tiles. Turn over two tiles and try to find identical images. Remember the positions of pictures that turn back over, then use those clues to complete the remaining pairs. Choose from three levels and aim to finish in fewer moves.

pages.title: Top 10 Soccer Managers
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Top 10 Soccer Managers puts you in charge of a European football club. Compare player stats, buy and sell players, and prepare your team for the fixtures on the calendar. Decide which players will strengthen the squad as the season develops. Work toward the top of the competition through transfers and match preparation.

pages.title: Exploration Lite: Mining
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Exploration Lite: Mining is a digging game where treasure lies below layers of blocks. Break the blocks to open a route deeper underground. Choose where to dig as you make your way toward a find. The game draws on Minecraft-style block exploration and lets you look for treasure at your own pace.

pages.title: Ghost in the Shell Major Motoko Kusanagi
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Ghost in the Shell Major Motoko Kusanagi is a dress-up game featuring the cyborg who leads a Public Security Section 9 squad. Try different clothing options on Motoko and compare how they look together. Change individual pieces as you go to create a version of the Major's outfit that suits the style you want.

pages.title: Angie Fashion Show!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Angie Fashion Show! lets you dress a cat for a live stage show. Pick pieces from the wardrobe and try them on Angie to see how they work together. Change any item you want as you build the outfit. Give her a coordinated look for her turn on the stage.
